review.headline: Fast and reliable
review.body: The setup was quick and the dataset built exactly as documented.

review.headline: Clear errors
review.body: The build failed until I fixed my mapping, but the error pointed at the exact field.

review.headline: Good for offline work
review.body: It works offline and the manifest gives me confidence in every release.

review.headline: Verifier caught a problem
review.body: The verifier caught a hand-edited record before the dataset reached training.

review.headline: Useful quality report
review.body: The quality report explains every rejected row and keeps the accounting easy to audit.

review.headline: Reproducible builds
review.body: Rebuilding from the same source produced identical records and the same manifest identity.

review.headline: Needs better docs
review.body: The command works, though I needed to read the configuration reference more than once.

review.headline: Strict mode helped
review.body: Strict mode stopped a malformed input file instead of silently publishing a partial dataset.

review.headline: Fast and reliable
review.body: The setup was quick and the dataset built exactly as documented.

review.headline: Mixed feelings
review.body: The output is useful but the current release is still a development preview.
